summary: Critical pre-auth RCE plus a high-severity SQL injection

Pre-auth reflected XSS on the login screen affecting every WordPress version; parser disagreement — a tag-like string with whitespace after the opening < survives wp_strip_all_tags() as text but wp_kses_post() treats it differently

Author-level-or-higher RCE via malicious file upload on sites using Imagick and Ghostscript; three-way trust-boundary mismatch (extension vs magic bytes vs PostScript); no CVE or CVSS published in available sources
